mechanism: Valproic acid may increase gastrointestinal irritation and ulceration risk when combined with risedronate, which is a known gastric irritant; additionally, valproic acid can affect bone metabolism and mineral absorption.
action: Monitor for gastrointestinal symptoms; ensure risedronate is taken with adequate water on an empty stomach as directed, separate from valproic acid dosing by at least 30 minutes; consider gastroprotection if GI symptoms develop.
